species.name: Barkdeer

dex.text: A small deer with a very big opinion, announcing danger to the whole wood in a series of sharp yaps. Has the good manners to be out of sight by the time anyone turns round.
dex.fact: The muntjac barks like a dog, which is why it is sometimes called the barking deer.

species.real: Muntjac came from China to Woburn Abbey in Bedfordshire in the early 1900s. Escapes and releases have since spread them across much of England, one rose bush at a time.

dex.text: A small deer that has taken up the fang. Barks at foxes, at fridge doors, and at anyone who looks at the roses.
dex.fact: Male muntjac have short tusks as well as small antlers, and Britain's muntjac descend from escapes and releases, many from Woburn in Bedfordshire, about a century ago.
